lines.en: The current pushes me along my patrol.

lines.zh: 我贴着河床滑行，寻找猎物
lines.en: I skim the riverbed, hunting for prey.
One flick of my tail shoots me forward.
I churn up mud in the shallows.

lines.zh: 同伴跟着我游成一条线
lines.en: My school trails behind me in a line.
I circle through the weeds.
I push upstream without effort.
My fins slice the surface.
The river bend is my patrol route.
I slip between the stones.

lines.zh: 水花跟着我的尾巴翻起
lines.en: Spray rises behind my tail.
I head for deeper water.
I sweep across the whole river.

lines.zh: 水下的影子一路跟着我
lines.en: Shadows trail me underwater.
I hover, only my gills moving.
I hold still and watch the ripples.

lines.zh: 水底的石头我看了一整天
lines.en: I have stared at this stone all day.
I am waiting for the scent of blood.
The water is cold, but my teeth itch.

lines.zh: 我把自己藏进水草的影子里
lines.en: I hide in the shadow of the weeds.
I turn once, then stop.

lines.zh: 水声太吵，我听不清岸上
lines.en: The water is too loud to hear the bank.

lines.zh: 我张合着嘴，试了试咬合
lines.en: I work my jaws, testing the bite.
I grind my teeth against the riverbed.
A small fish nears, then flees.
I stare at the light on the surface.
Weeds catch on my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 我等着什么东西掉进河里
lines.en: I wait for something to fall in.
You stand on the bank, and I smell you.
I surface just enough to show my eyes.

lines.zh: 我把你水上的影子盯牢了。
lines.en: I've fixed on your shadow on the water.
I circle your reflection.
Do not put your hand in here.
I watch you with my jaws half open.
That rock you stand on is mine.
I tilt up, sizing you.
Do you smell of blood?
I meet your eyes from below.
An inch of water divides us.
I circle right at your feet.
My scales are torn open.
The blood in the water is mine.
It hurts, but I grow meaner.
I flick my tail away from the next blow.
I remember the scent of whoever hits me.
My gills are trembling.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的巡游
lines.en: That broke my patrol.
I clamp my jaw and swallow the pain.
The river washes my blood away.
One flick of my tail still carries me.
That scent of blood is mine.
Whatever meat is thrown, I take.
My teeth are ready.

lines.zh: 有东西在滴水，我听见了
lines.en: Something is dripping, and I hear it.
Do not dangle it, or I will follow.
This morsel will not feed the school.
I will take a bite first and ask later.
The smell of blood drives me wild.
I chase it along the surface.
My school smells it too.
You crossed into my water.

lines.zh: 我顶了你一下，骨头碰骨头
lines.en: I bump you, bone against bone.
Do not crowd, this pool is full.
Your boot heel grinds across my tail.
The shove knocks me off course.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水花四溅
lines.en: We collide, spraying water everywhere.
Who is pushing me?
My scales scraped you.
Move aside, I am coming through.
I will remember that bump.
The water warms when the eggs come.
My mate waits down the bend.

lines.zh: 我们要找一片安静的水草
lines.en: We need a quiet patch of weeds.
This river can feed a whole school.
Do not come close, we guard the eggs.
I circle her three times.
The current will carry the eggs downstream.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会比我更凶
lines.en: Our young will be fiercer than me.
This stretch of riverbed is ours.
I stand guard and bite whoever comes.

lines.zh: 这东西掉进水里就是我的
lines.en: Whatever falls in the water is mine.
I snatch it and shake it twice.
You fumbled it—now it's mine.
Shiny or not, I bite it.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里带回巢
lines.en: I carry it back to the nest in my jaws.
This one is for my young.
I try to bite through it.
Too heavy to lift, so I drag it in my teeth.
My teeth marks are on it now.
No one is taking it back.
That smell of blood, it is you.
I have decided you are prey.
You moved, and I saw it.
One big catch feeds the school.
My tooth roots itch—I've locked on.
The moment you stepped into the water.

lines.zh: 我不管你是鲨鱼还是别的
lines.en: Shark or not, I do not care.
I bite the big ones too.
My target is your ankle.
I turn and come for you.
The splash is my signal to move.
A straggler is easy prey.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脉搏数拍子。
lines.en: I count the beats of your pulse.

lines.zh: 你身上的血味越来越近
lines.en: Your blood-scent grows closer.
I circle you, round and round.
I am looking for your ankle.
Do not turn, I am right behind.
You shift half a step; I close half a step.

lines.zh: 水下的我看得比你清楚
lines.en: Underwater I see better than you.
I glide low along the riverbed.
Changing direction will not help.
I wait for your misstep.
My school is closing in.
Your legs are slow in water.
I can smell your panic.
One of me, then the whole school.
Once I bite, I don't let go.
The river is too narrow to escape.
I press the ripples ahead as I close in.
My jaws close on your leg.
My teeth sink into flesh.
This bite carries fifty times my weight.
Did you hear the bone crack?
I thrash and tear a piece loose.
Blood reddens the water.
I thrash and tear off another piece.
Do not struggle, it only sinks deeper.

lines.zh: 我的牙是圆的，咬合力却大
lines.en: Round teeth, but the bite is strong.
You kicked me, so now I am meaner.

lines.zh: 我的牙都是往小腿去的
lines.en: My teeth all go for the calf.
That one you will remember.

lines.zh: 我的同类都学会了我这口
lines.en: My school learns this bite from me.
The splash drowns out your shout.

lines.zh: 我从河底的阴影里浮上来
lines.en: I rise from the shadow of the riverbed.
The river has one more set of teeth.
My head pushes out of the weeds.
I smell a new river.
There are too few fish here.
I swam all the way down from upstream.
My school is waiting for me.

lines.zh: 水底的石头还不认识我
lines.en: The stones do not know me yet.
I break the surface open.
This river, I have arrived.
Whoever enters first is unlucky.
My first bite caught only air.
The smell of the river has changed.

lines.zh: 我摆尾，宣告这片水域换主人
lines.en: I flick my tail and claim this water.
So many shadows on the bank.
My teeth gleam underwater.
From today, this place is mine.
A new trail of bubbles on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 河水烧得滚烫，我弹起来
lines.en: The water boils and I leap out.
Beached and gasping for water.

lines.zh: 水灌满我的鳃，我也呛了
lines.en: Water floods my gills and even I choke.
The blast slams me back onto the riverbed.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进了我的背鳍
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my dorsal fin.
Magic numbs my scales.

lines.zh: 河里没有鱼了，我饿得发抖
lines.en: No fish left, and I am shaking with hunger.
Lightning runs through the river into me.

lines.zh: 我被拽出水面，掉进空白
lines.en: Dragged out of the water into nothing.
